documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment of ESOP / ESPS
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Marksans Pharma reported record performance for Q2 FY27 with revenue reaching INR940 crores and EBITDA growing to INR214 crores. Management highlighted strong momentum across Europe, the UK, North America, and Australia, supported by geographic diversification and strategic initiatives. The company remains optimistic about reaching its long-term revenue targets and expanding its manufacturing capabilities. While facing higher freight and inventory costs, management remains focused on disciplined capital allocation and profitable growth. Marksans Pharma reported record performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, with Q2 revenue reaching Rs 940 crore (up 30.5% YoY) and EBITDA growing 48.3% to Rs 214 crore.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the company is trending towards achieving INR5,000 crores in the next three years.
guidance.quote: We do believe we are trending and we are working and trending towards achieving INR5,000 crores in the next three years and possibly doubling our revenue from where we were last year within the next five years, INR6,000 odd crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects to hit the INR4,000 crores revenue mark next year.
guidance.quote: I think next year we should touch INR4,000 crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA to be range-bound between 21% and 22% for the year.
guidance.quote: I think our EBITDA should be pretty much in the range of 21%-22%, whatever we performed this year, this quarter.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the U.S. order book status is expected to reach $300 million over the next three years.
guidance.quote: Within the next three years, I do believe our order book will increase from $225 million to $300 million.

guidance.claim: Management expects Australia to grow into a $100 million subsidiary over the next three years.
guidance.quote: We see Australia growing over the next three years to a $100 million subsidiary.

guidance.claim: The company expects QliniQ to generate INR150 crores to INR175 crores in overall revenue for the year.
guidance.quote: We expect QliniQ will do around INR150 crores to INR175 crores in terms of the revenue overall for the year.

guidance.claim: Management stated that Europe is expected to achieve around INR180 crores in revenue.
guidance.quote: So we do expect Europe to be somewhere around INR180 crores to -- yes, about INR180 crores. You can put it at INR180 crores.

guidance.claim: The company remains on target to hit INR4,000 crores within the next two years.
guidance.quote: We do anticipate us -- I mean, we are still very much on our target of hitting INR4,000 crores within the next two years.

guidance.claim: Management stands by its revenue growth projection of 15% to 20% and EBITDA margin of 20% to 21% due to ongoing geopolitical uncertainties.
guidance.quote: So like -- and also, we have guided for FY27 revenue growth of 15% to 20% and 20% to 21% EBITDA margin. So, is there any plan to revise based on the upward side, or how should we look at it? Mark Saldanha: No, I think we'll stick with that plan because of the volatility that you see, the geopolitical scenarios that you see prevailing, surrounding us and pretty much all countries.

guidance.claim: Management stated that an end-of-year EBITDA margin of 21% to 22% is achievable.
guidance.quote: By the end of the year 21% to 22 percentage? Mark Saldanha: Yes. End of the year, 21% to 22% is achievable. Yes.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the Rest of World business was impacted by ongoing geopolitical disruptions in the Middle East affecting shipment timing.
demand_outlook.quote: Our Rest of World business remained impacted in the quarter by ongoing geopolitical disruptions in the Middle East and other regions, which affected the timing of certain shipments in the region.

demand_outlook.claim: Management mentioned that geopolitical scenarios, inflation, and crude oil prices impact affordability in the U.S. market.
demand_outlook.quote: That said and done, obviously, when we talk of sentiments, we talk about the geopolitical scenarios where we talk of inflation, crude oil, everything of that stuff, having impact on affordability in the U.S.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that European markets are starting from zero and will be a prominent contributor to objectives.
demand_outlook.quote: Definitely, it is adding to being a growth driver presently. We are literally starting from zero where Europe is concerned.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that U.K. and Europe will continue to grow over the next couple of years.
demand_outlook.quote: If you ask me my outlook of U.K. and Europe, they will still continue to grow over the next couple of years and will be very important geographies to hit our objectives of INR6,000 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Order books remain strong despite a softer US consumer environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Order book remains strong despite a softer US consumer environment, supporting the outlook for H2FY27

demand_outlook.claim: Price erosion in the Rx portfolio remained in single digits.
demand_outlook.quote: Price erosion in the Rx portfolio remained in single digits

demand_outlook.claim: Australia and New Zealand revenue performance followed normal seasonal patterns after a strong fourth quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: This was in line with our normal seasonal pattern, following a particularly strong fourth quarter during the Southern Hemisphere winter.

demand_outlook.claim: Markets outside western regions are struggling due to war scenarios and transportation hurdles.
demand_outlook.quote: Obviously, the other markets besides the western markets are struggling a bit because of the war scenarios, because of vessels unable to pass and the transportation becoming one of the biggest hurdles in those regions.

demand_outlook.claim: Q2 revenue is expected to be better than Q1, with Q3 likely being the strongest.
demand_outlook.quote: And I think from an EBITDA point of view, we will hit our expected margins that we have presented to that level, yes. But revenue, definitely, the Q2 will be better than the Q1 and Q3 will be probably the strongest.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated the company is looking at opportunities to expand manufacturing infrastructure by adding a manufacturing block or acquiring another plant.
capex_expansion.quote: It may be adding on another manufacturing block or acquiring another plant.

capex_expansion.claim: Management expects to expand manufacturing capabilities within 12 months.
capex_expansion.quote: We are looking at basically expanding our manufacturing capabilities, hopefully, maybe for which we will probably need a year down the line or so.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that capacity expansion will happen within the Teva plant facility by adding blocks and debottlenecking.
capex_expansion.quote: One is within our facility, within our infrastructure that we have within the Teva plant, we are planning to add in a couple of blocks to expand dosage forms as well as some capacity, debottlenecking.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated the company deployed around INR95 crores towards acquisitions during the first half.
capex_expansion.quote: During H1, we deployed around INR95 crores towards acquisitions and paid a dividend of around INR41 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Marksans has a plan to double its existing Indian capacity to 16 billion units per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Aim to expand Indian capacity to 16bn units p.a. Plan to manufacture tablets, hard capsules, ointments, liquids, and creams

capex_expansion.claim: Net capex for the quarter stood at INR33 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: After net capex of INR33 crores, free cash flow stood at INR152 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed the acquisition of QliniQ B.V in the Netherlands during the quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, we completed the acquisition of QliniQ B.V in Netherlands, which contributed approximately INR44 crores of revenue in Q1.

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed the acquisition of ABCnow GmbH in Germany, with consolidation commencing from Q2.
capex_expansion.quote: We then completed the acquisition of ABCnow GmbH, Germany with consolidation commencing from Q2.

capex_expansion.claim: Marksans Pharma Europe has been established in Ireland and Marksans Pharma GmbH in Germany.
capex_expansion.quote: Alongside these acquisitions, we have established Marksans Pharma Europe in Ireland and Marksans Pharma GmbH in Germany.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that freight costs have nearly doubled in the current environment.
margins_costs.quote: Notably, freight costs have nearly doubled in the current environment.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that higher freight contributed approximately INR20 crores to the sequential increase in other expenses.
margins_costs.quote: Higher freight contributed approximately INR20 crores to the sequential increase in other expenses.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported a slight increase in employee costs of approximately INR8 crores.
margins_costs.quote: There has also been a slight increase in employee costs, of approximately INR8 crores, as we continue to strengthen our team and invest in the newer markets.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that the German business incurred initial startup costs of a couple of crores.
margins_costs.quote: In addition, our German business incurred initial startup costs of a couple of crores as we prepare these operations for the next phase.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that gross margin moved to 58.5% from 59.1% in the previous quarter due to increased inventory costs.
margins_costs.quote: However, we are now seeing an increase in inventory costs, resulting in gross margin moving to 58.5% from 59.1% in the previous quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Q2FY27 EBITDA margin expanded 274 bps YoY to 22.8%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA grew 48.3% to a record ₹214 crore, with margins expanding 274 bps to 22.8%.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit for Q1 FY27 reached INR497.3 crores, with gross margin expanding by 138 basis points year-on-year to 59.1%.
margins_costs.quote: Gross profit stood at INR497.3 crores, up 38.9% year-on-year from INR358.2 crores. While gross margin improved to 59.1% from 57.8%, an expansion of 138 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY27 stood at INR213 crores with an EBITDA margin of 25.3%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR213 crores, compared with INR100.1 crores in Q1 FY26, representing 112.8% year-on-year growth. EBITDA margin expanded to 25.3% from 16.1%, an improvement Page 3 of 15 Marksans Pharma Limited August 13, 2026 of 919 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after-tax for the quarter stood at INR159.4 crores with a PAT margin of 18.4%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after-tax stood at INR159.4 crores compared with INR58.2 crores in Q1 FY26, representing a 173.9% year-on-year increase. PAT margin improved to 18.4% from 9.3%

margins_costs.claim: Management expects normalized gross margins to be around 55% to 56%.
margins_costs.quote: And yes, in terms of sustainability of that 25-odd percent -- yes, 59%, I think we should be around 55%, 56% gross margin per se.

orders_capacity.claim: Management noted that the company is good for capacity for the next two to three years.
orders_capacity.quote: So far, we are good for the next two years, two to three years.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book for the U.S. business remains strong.
orders_capacity.quote: Well, we do see -- the order book is still strong. So that's not a problem.

orders_capacity.claim: Revenue generation from the Teva facility in Goa is currently at INR50-plus crores against a projection of INR80 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: The Teva facility is progressing. We had projected about moving towards an INR80 crores revenue generation from that plant. We are right now at INR50-plus crores. So I think we are pretty much at 60% to 65% out there.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that free cash flow stood at INR275 crores after capital expenditure of INR46 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: After capital expenditure of INR46 crores, free cash flow stood at INR275 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the net cash position increased by INR135 crores during the period.
capital_allocation.quote: Even after these outflows, our net cash position increased by INR135 crores during the period.

capital_allocation.claim: Management noted that cash balance and current investments stood at INR1,124 crores as of September end.
capital_allocation.quote: As of September end, cash balance and current investments stood at INR1,124 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the net cash position was at INR1,095 crores with a net worth of INR3,367 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position was therefore at INR1,095 crores, while net worth stood at INR3,367 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Management noted that historically, about one-third of free cash flow generation has been distributed as dividend.
capital_allocation.quote: Historically, like, 1/3 of our free cash flow generation, we have been distributing as dividend.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash from operations during the quarter was INR185 crores, leading to a free cash flow of INR152 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated INR185 crores of cash from operations during the quarter. After net capex of INR33 crores, free cash flow stood at INR152 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company ended the quarter with a cash balance of INR1,058 crores and net cash of INR1,031 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We ended the quarter with a cash balance of INR1,058 crores compared with INR711 crores at the end of Q1 FY2026. While the net cash stood at INR1,031 crores, this was achieved despite the payment towards the QliniQ acquisition during the quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital cycle improved to approximately 132 days.
capital_allocation.quote: Our working capital cycle improved to approximately 132 days compared with approximately 159 days in Q1 FY2026 and 138 days forFY2026 as a whole

capital_allocation.claim: R&D spend for the quarter was INR23.2 crores, accounting for 2.8% of consolidated revenue.
capital_allocation.quote: R&D spend for the quarter was INR23.2 crores or 2.8% of consolidated revenue compared with INR12.1 crores and 2% in Q1 of FY2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the Rest of World business was impacted by geopolitical disruptions in the Middle East affecting shipment timings.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our Rest of World business remained impacted in the quarter by ongoing geopolitical disruptions in the Middle East and other regions, which affected the timing of certain shipments in the region.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that freight costs have nearly doubled in the current environment.
risks_headwinds.quote: Notably, freight costs have nearly doubled in the current environment.

risks_headwinds.claim: RoW revenue declined amidst the West Asia crisis which impacted Middle East shipments.
risks_headwinds.quote: Revenue declined 47.0% YoY and 29.6% QoQ, amidst the West Asia crisis.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted fluid situations and war-related impacts on freight and raw material costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: So obviously, it's a very fluid situation. And you're right, we were sitting on good inventory, which we are depleting over time. We still have some inventory, but there are obviously other parameters within the war -- due to the war, which is having an impact like freight or some higher cost of raw material coming in
